_about: The shot list as data: copy to jobs/<job>/shots.json and fill it from the approved shot-list.md.
tools/film/scaffold.mjs turns it into the film skeleton. Scene times are not written here: they come from the voice (audio/lines.json).
scene.lines: ids of the voice lines the scene covers, from audio/script.json. Every voice line belongs to exactly one scene, in order.
scene.transition_in: number and name from knowledge/craft/03-transitions.md; null for the first scene. scene.hand_off: the object that carries the change, or null.
shot.text: the on-screen text, at most seven words. \n starts the second clause, *word* sets one word in the italic serif. Empty when the shot has no text.
shot.line (optional): the voice line the text arrives with. Left out, shots follow the scene's lines in order.
shot.size: wide | medium | macro | abstract. shot.capture: a file inside the job folder, or null.
stage: light | dark, the look approved at the moodboard.

scene.silent and scene.seconds (optional): a scene with no voice, such as an end card with the logo, the web address and a button. Write "silent": true and "seconds": 2.5 and leave out "lines". It starts after the sound has ended and adds its seconds to the film, so it holds in silence. Between 1.5 and 6 seconds reads well; outside that the scaffold warns you.

Silent scenes can only come at the end, after the last voice line. The film's sound is one track with the voice, music and effects mixed together, so a pause in the middle would cut the music and push later lines out of step. For a silent beat between lines, leave a pause in the voice script instead.
The example below is a three-scene film whose script has the lines 01, 02 and 03, then a silent end card.

planned_instant_changes.what: match cut into the closing line

planned_holds.what: proof hold on the finished board

scenes.title: The proof
scenes.hand_off: the full stop of the headline becomes the cursor

shots.move: cursor drags a card to Done
hero push into the card, then hold

scenes.title: The close
scenes.hand_off: the card's rounded corner matches the wordmark tile

shots.move: wordmark settles, text rises under it
shots.sound: hit on the cut, pad resolves

scenes.title: End card
scenes.hand_off: the wordmark stays while the background settles

shots.move: wordmark holds, web address and button fade in under it
